description: Source code for the Mattermost server configuration store, including the Store class, BackingStore interface, and related methods for managing configuration data, loading, saving, and file operations.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Represents the configuration store, managing config data with thread safety, persistence, and environment variable overrides.

classes.name: BackingStore
classes.description: Interface defining methods for underlying storage implementations such as file or database storage.

methods.name: NewStoreFromBacking
methods.description: Creates a new Store instance from a given backing store, loading initial configuration.

methods.name: NewStoreFromDSN
methods.description: Creates a new Store backed by a database or file based on the provided DSN.

methods.name: NewTestMemoryStore
methods.description: Creates a new in-memory Store for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetNoEnv
methods.description: Returns the current cached configuration without environment variable overrides.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentOverrides
methods.description: Fetches configuration fields overridden by environment variables.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentOverridesWithFilter
methods.description: Fetches environment variable overrides with an optional filter.

methods.name: RemoveEnvironmentOverrides
methods.description: Returns a new config with environment overrides removed.

methods.name: SetReadOnlyFF
methods.description: Sets whether feature flags are read-only.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Replaces the current configuration and persists it, returning old and new configs.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads configuration data from the backing store.

methods.name: GetFile
methods.description: Retrieves contents of a persisted configuration file.

methods.name: SetFile
methods.description: Sets or replaces a configuration file's contents.

methods.name: HasFile
methods.description: Checks if a configuration file exists.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string description of the backing store.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the store.

methods.name: IsReadOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the store is read-only.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Removes outdated configurations from the database, no-op for file store.
